events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite legendary Woodstock performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977, aged 42.

angles.name: King's Enduring Reign
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King, but his music still reigns supreme. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and passed away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur on music and culture. His words still resonate decades on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27.

angles.name: Guitar God's Influence
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. What's your favourite riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album turns 57 today. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, in 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when you could carry '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, changing music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A truly diverse collection of tracks.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, aged 45.

angles.name: Legendary Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
